central_idea_and_construction: One bold plum silhouette for a seasonal-cooking app. Broad slightly pear-shaped purple fruit with unequal rounded shoulders and a small dimple at the top; one smooth softly curved cleft enters from that dimple and ends well above the bottom, expressed by a slightly lighter broad purple shape rather than a thin line. A short sturdy stem supports one generous green leaf angled right; the leaf has no veins. Intentional gentle asymmetry and a slightly flattened bottom distinguish it from a plain purple circle. Flat filled color, no specular highlight, face, droplet, glossy skin, gradients or realistic food photography. Fruit and leaf form one compact center composition around65% width and76% height. Uniform marigold-yellow background fills the complete square to the edges, with no enclosing tile or external shadow.
small_size_signature: Unequal fruit shoulders, upper dimple and one leaf.
specific_risk: Common fruit subject does not establish uniqueness; purple cleft must survive small sizes.
reference_transfer: User negative references analyzed as text; no screenshot conditioning and no positive brand-copy reference.
observations: Recorded separately after viewing the native original.
